messages.subject: reset actionButton value
parts:
Hi ! I have a problem with the actionButton value when I recreate new actionButton with same id as previous. This is an example :

1 - I create three actionButton with these ids : id1, id2 and id3.

2 - The user click the button with id2, the value of this button is then equal to one (input$id2 == 1)

3- I detect the click and I replace the three previous buttons by two new buttons with these ids : id5, id2

4- If I check the value of input$id2 it is still equal to one while I was expecting value equal to zero.

I hope my problem is clear ...

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: reset actionButton value
parts:
Shiny works by looking at the id? So if the id is still id2 then it will remember the value. 

In other words even if you destroy the dom element and replaced it with another element, as long as the id is the same it would still be captured and the count won't be reset.

This is based on my current understanding of shiny (v0.8.)
